result.topic_en: Formulas for the indirect computation of the latitude difference, azimuth difference and a third quantity P between two geodetic stations, with control relations and a numerical example for Kirchhesepe and Quickenberg.
result.transcription:
Zur indirecten Bestimmung von $\varphi'-\varphi$, $R$, $P$ sind folgende Formeln sehr bequem, wo Kürze halber
$\varphi^* = \frac{1}{2}(\varphi+\varphi')$, $R^* = \frac{1}{2}(R+R')$ geschrieben ist

$\varphi'-\varphi = \alpha Q \cos R^*$
$R'-R = \beta Q \sin R^* \tang \varphi^*$
$P = \frac{\gamma Q \sin R^*}{\cos\varphi^*}$
und zur Controlle
$I + III = II + IV$

$\log\alpha = \frac{III + 2.IV}{3}$
$\log\beta = \frac{III + 2.I}{3}$
$\log\gamma = \frac{IV - I}{3} = \frac{III - II}{3}$
$I = \log\sec\frac{1}{2}Q$
$II = \log\sec\frac{1}{2}(\varphi'-\varphi)$
$III = \log.\sec\frac{1}{2}(R'-R)$
$IV = \log.\sec\frac{1}{2}P$

Beispiel
Kirchhesepe $\varphi = 52^\circ 37' 32''228$ $\zeta = 284^\circ 54' 46''185$ $R = 284^\circ 55' 48''900$
Quickenberg $\varphi' = 52\ 32\ 23,585$ $\zeta' = 285.19.36,011$ $R' = 285.20.40,210$

methods.what: Latitude difference from distance Q and mean azimuth
Azimuth difference from distance, mean azimuth and mean latitude
Correction factors alpha, beta, gamma via log-secant terms of half quantities
Reduced latitude substitution to simplify the formulas

items.quote: Alle diese Vorschriften lassen sich mit viel einfachern vertauschen wenn man die wahren Azimuthe beibehält, und für veränderte Polhöhen $\psi$ einführt
items.english: All these rules can be exchanged for much simpler ones if one keeps the true azimuths and introduces altered pole heights (latitudes) psi
